description: Update prices of up to 5000 variants in one synchronous, atomic request — the fast path for syncing a whole catalog instead of calling update_variant per item. If a single item is invalid (variant unknown or archived, variant listed twice, price malformed, discount price above the base price) the whole request is rejected with 400 and NOTHING is applied; the response `errors` list names every offending variant. Both price fields are optional per item: omit a key to keep the current value, or send null to reset it (resetting `price` works only on unpublished variants). Changing `price` recomputes the promo price; promo membership is refreshed in the background afterwards.

items.description: Price updates, 1-5000 items, one entry per variant.

manual_discount_price.description: New manually set discounted price. Must not exceed price. Omit to keep the current value; null clears the manual discount.

price.description: New base price (before discounts), e.g. 1000 or "1000.00". Omit to keep the current price; null resets it (unpublished variants only).

variant_id.description: Variant ID (UUID). Must not repeat within a batch.

name: bulk_update_prices
title: Bulk update prices
